name: Del Amo Fashion Center
summary: Large mall offers trendy retailers, restaurants & a theater, plus a garden-inspired dining pavilion.
description: Del Amo Fashion Center is one of the largest shopping destinations in Southern California, offering an exceptional retail experience with a diverse mix of premium fashion brands, dining options, and entertainment venues. Operated by Simon Property Group, this expansive center features both open-air and enclosed sections, providing shoppers with a comprehensive selection of stores ranging from luxury retailers to popular national brands.
demographics: Del Amo Fashion Center attracts a diverse demographic mix from the affluent South Bay communities of Torrance, Redondo Beach, and Rolling Hills Estates, with shoppers predominantly in the 25-54 age range and household incomes ranging from middle to upper-middle class ($75,000-$150,000+). The trade area serves a combination of established families, young professionals, and Asian-American communities who value quality retail options and demonstrate strong purchasing power. Visitors typically engage in destination shopping trips, spending time across multiple stores and dining establishments, with a preference for both aspirational brands and practical everyday retailers.
